posts.title: empowering people with software
posts.description: Code Lyoko is an animated kids show made by some french studio that aired in english on Cartoon Network when i was a kid. in each episode a computer virus named X.A.N.A. manipulates the real world by manifesting in different ways while a team of four high school hacker friends with different skill sets fight back through a VR universe. this feels like a metaphor to me.
